summary: Unpacks six packed 16-bit integers from an input buffer into six floats in the output object. The first four are read as unsigned 16-bit values scaled by 0.000015259022 (1/65536) into this[0..3]; the last two are read as signed 16-bit values scaled by 0.0078125 (1/128) into this[4..5]. Returns the raw signed 16-bit value at input offset 18. Called by CarPositionTargetCheck (004FE060).

local_names.a2: packed 16-bit input buffer; fields read at +8,+10,+12,+14 (unsigned) and +16,+18 (signed)
local_names.this: output float array receiving six unpacked components

operations.description: this[5] = (int16)a2[+18] * 0.0078125 (second signed component); the raw signed value is also the return value
Return the raw signed 16-bit value read from input offset 18
Invoked by CarPositionTargetCheck (004FE060) to decode packed 16-bit target data into floats
